name: POMA Grill
description:
POMA Grill is a managed context engine, letting you add files that can act as easily-searchable context for Claude. It can parse and search PDFs, CSVs, HTML, XLS, and 50+ more filetypes - even URLs! It also supports more than 80 languages, as well as searching within images and video.

It's built for users and teams who have document stores that they want to use as a handy context layer when using Claude, while still maintaining privacy and security. It's great for anyone working with structured, complex documents, such as regulatory text or scanned PDFs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add POMA Grill to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add POMA Grill to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.poma-ai.com/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the POMA Grill MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: POMA Grill provides these MCP tools: grill_docs_list, grill_explain, grill_ingest, grill_ingest_batch, grill_ingest_resume, grill_ingest_sync, grill_jobs_status, grill_projects, and grill_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to POMA Grill?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to POMA Grill in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does POMA Grill MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: POMA Grill requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
POMA Grill is developed by POMA AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
